Inference 'no fee cash flow' not stated; splitting into atomic findings.
Grant of liability and direction to fix amount are the two operative paragraphs of one order on one obligation; together they establish 'liability decided, amount open'.
The procedural chronology serves one claim: the amount of the fee award is pending decision.
The pending amount relates to a potential future cash payment to Elysium, not merely an accounting entry; the finding only states the amount is unfixed.

One disclosure sentence group describing a single contingent obligation (appeal intent, accounting assessment and exposure amount are its attributes); the host coverage check requires these stated together.
Unaccrued (reasonably possible) status is accounting, but the underlying exposure is a potential cash outflow of up to ~$9.8M if the appeal fails; treated as a live dispute with cash paths.
Single balance-sheet-date liquidity statement from one sentence; the cash figure contextualises the undrawn line.
Undrawn line is a backup liquidity source subject to covenants.
One sentence of contractual commitments; the host coverage check requires both obligations in the cited sentence to be stated.
Ordinary-course outflows already reflected in baseline bank outflows (contract manufacturers, landlord).
Covenant list and consequence of breach describe one contractual constraint; coverage check requires covenant and default terms stated together.
